svg.title: PicoClaw pull-request event and data flow with editable lifecycle gates
svg.desc: An end-to-end data-flow diagram beginning with a GitHub review request. It shows the event inbox and explicit workspace handoff, verified PR data, charter, review and nudge agents, findings, implementation, validation, publication and correction data, with all fourteen lifecycle gates linked to their editor locations.

g.text: PR event, data, agent, and gate flow
Start at the GitHub review assignment. Follow named payloads through durable data, explicit actions, AI work, editable gates, and independent provider effects.
Click or focus any numbered gate to edit it
Arrows name the data being transferred. Solid = normal path · dashed = conditional path or loop.
AUTOMATIC INGRESS, THEN AN EXPLICIT HANDOFF
GitHub review request → generic event inbox → tracked PR workspace
GitHub is never acknowledged or mutated here
target_user and target_reason are routing data
User supplies the PR URL in Pull Requests,
or a custom configured workflow does so.
The GitHub assignment alone does not create,
open, or start a PR workspace.
Verified PR data → charter gates → review agent and nudges → finding gates

a.title: Open pr.charter.confirm in the gate profile editor

a.aria-label: Edit gate 2, Confirm revised PR charter
a.title: Open pr.charter.reconfirm in the gate profile editor
Open pr.review.start in the gate profile editor
Open pr.review.complete in the gate profile editor
Open pr.finding.classify in the gate profile editor

g.text: EDITABLE GATE · HUMAN · PER AMBIGUOUS FINDING
S1 / large S0: in scope, defer, revise, dismiss
review publish and implementation branch here
revise → charter revision → gate #2; later head changes require explicit Refresh
EXPLICIT RUN IMPLEMENTATION · DEFAULT MAXIMUM THREE REPAIR CYCLES
Triaged in-scope findings → repair candidate → scope and type evidence → validation → completion

a.aria-label: Edit gate 6, Authorize non-owned PR implementation
a.title: Open pr.implementation.eligibility in the gate profile editor

g.text: Authorize implementation on a non-owned PR
Owned PR bypasses #6; writable head never bypassed

a.title: Open pr.implementation.start in the gate profile editor

g.text: pinned local Git workspace; authorized findings only
SHA · changed files · semantic lines · modules
one record per real hunk · S0–S3 · XS–L
candidate S2 / S3 / type mismatch → fixed hard policy

a.title: Open pr.implementation.scope in the gate profile editor

g.text: Configurable: large S0 or S1 work
Profile stages may pass, revise, defer, or block
MANDATORY HARD-SCOPE RESOLUTION · SAME POINT, FIXED POLICY
remove code + clone deferred follow-up · revise charter · stop
This is not a fifteenth configurable gate.
everything required done? anything outside scope?
Check again variants run even after “done”

a.title: Open pr.implementation.complete in the gate profile editor

g.text: Pass stores retained commit + exact publication fence
missing work or red validation → repair → scope audit → validate again
remove candidate code + defer follow-up → repair again
revise authority → charter section above → reconfirm (#2)
completion follow_up → deferred group; candidate_present drift → mandatory hard scope
EXPLICIT QUEUE COMMANDS · FROZEN PAYLOADS · BACKGROUND PUBLICATION WORKER
Review publication, branch publication, and deferred issue publication are independent effects

a.title: Open pr.review.publish in the gate profile editor

g.text: later workspace edits cannot change it

a.title: Open pr.implementation.publish in the gate profile editor

a.aria-label: Edit gate 12, Create deferred GitHub issue
a.title: Open pr.deferred.publish in the gate profile editor

g.text: EDITABLE GATE · HUMAN IN ASK MODE
never expands the current PR scope
Feedback changes later prompt data immediately; external ambiguity requires a separate gate
never grants gate, Git, or provider authority

a.title: Open pr.correction.promote in the gate profile editor

g.text: write may have happened; never retry blindly

a.aria-label: Edit gate 14, Resolve ambiguous provider outcome
a.title: Open pr.publication.reconcile in the gate profile editor

g.text: PASS re-observes · BLOCK assumes failure and unlocks
absence alone is not proof of failure
or remain unknown; no duplicate write

Default profile stages: #3, #4, #7 = ZERO; the other eleven = HUMAN. Profiles may replace configurable gates with ordered ZERO, deterministic, AI-working, AI-isolated, and human stages. Any non-pass stops later stages.
No merge authority · no automatic workspace creation from review_requested · no blind publication retry · no configurable bypass of hard candidate scope.
